hints.title: Superlinear Quadratic Bottleneck Obstacle
hints.text: Quadratic sorting algorithms exceed runtime limits on lists of 50,000 nodes. How can you divide the list into equal halves and merge them in linearithmic time?

hints.title: Divide-and-Conquer Midpoint Split Invariant
hints.text: Split the list at its midpoint using fast and slow markers, recursively sort both halves, and merge the sorted sublists.

hints.title: Recursive Halving and Merge Procedure
hints.text: Base case: if head is null or head.next is null, return head. Find mid using slow and fast, disconnect the left half by setting prev.next to null, recursively sort both halves, and merge the two sorted lists with a sentinel dummy node.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def sortList(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        if not head or not head.next:
            return head
        prev = None
        slow = head
        fast = head
        while fast and fast.next:
            prev = slow
            slow = slow.next
            fast = fast.next.next
        prev.next = None
        l1 = self.sortList(head)
        l2 = self.sortList(slow)
        dummy = ListNode(0)
        curr = dummy
        while l1 and l2:
            if l1.val <= l2.val:
                curr.next = l1
                l1 = l1.next
            else:
                curr.next = l2
                l2 = l2.next
            curr = curr.next
        curr.next = l1 if l1 else l2
        return dummy.next
```

variables: N: number of nodes in list (0 <= N <= 5 * 10^4)
complexity.notes: Merge sort dividing the list recursively at midpoints and merging in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic sorts like bubble, selection, or insertion take O(N^2) time, which times out when N = 50,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Divide-and-conquer mergesort achieves the theoretical lower bound O(N log N) using O(log N) recursion frames.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accurate midpoint finding and clean sentinel merge sub-routine without cyclic pointers.
